description: This file defines two Sass mixins, 'visually-hidden' and 'visually-hidden-focusable', used for accessibility purposes to visually hide elements while keeping them accessible for assistive technologies.

methods.name: visually-hidden
methods.description: Mixin that visually hides elements while keeping them accessible to assistive technologies.

methods.name: visually-hidden-focusable
methods.description: Mixin that shows elements only when they or their children are focused, useful for skip links.
